segments.source: The audio channel layout tag of the audio sample buffers produced by the audio data output.
segments.ko: audio data output에서 생성한 오디오 샘플 버퍼의 오디오 채널 레이아웃 태그입니다.

segments.source: When you set your audio data output’s associated [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) property to `AVCaptureMultichannelAudioModeFirstOrderAmbisonics`, the [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md) allows up to two [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) instances to be connected to the First-order Ambisonsics (FOA) input.
segments.ko: audio data output의 관련 [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) 속성을 `AVCaptureMultichannelAudioModeFirstOrderAmbisonics`로 설정하면, [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md)에서 First-order Ambisonsics(FOA) 입력에 최대 두 개의 [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) 인스턴스를 연결할 수 있습니다.

segments.source: If you connect a single [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) instance, you must configure its [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) property to produce either four channels of FOA audio or two channels of Stereo audio.
segments.ko: 단일 [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) 인스턴스를 연결하는 경우에는 [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) 속성을 FOA 오디오 4채널 또는 스테레오 오디오 2채널을 생성하도록 구성해야 합니다.

segments.source: If you connect two [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) instances, you must configure one to output four channels of FOA audio and the other to output two channels of Stereo audio.
segments.ko: 두 개의 [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) 인스턴스를 연결하는 경우에는 하나는 FOA 오디오 4채널을 출력하고 다른 하나는 스테레오 오디오 2채널을 출력하도록 구성해야 합니다.

segments.source: Thus, when you set your associated [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) property to `AVCaptureMultichannelAudioModeFirstOrderAmbisonics`, you must set your connected [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) instance’s [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) property to either `kAudioChannelLayoutTag_Stereo` for stereo, or `(kAudioChannelLayoutTag_HOA_ACN_SN3D | 4)` for FOA (see [`AudioChannelLayoutTag`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreAudioTypes/AudioChannelLayoutTag)).
segments.ko: 따라서 [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) 속성을 `AVCaptureMultichannelAudioModeFirstOrderAmbisonics`로 설정하면, 연결된 [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md) 인스턴스의 [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) 속성을 스테레오의 경우 `kAudioChannelLayoutTag_Stereo`, FOA의 경우 `(kAudioChannelLayoutTag_HOA_ACN_SN3D | 4)`(을/를)으로 설정해야 합니다([`AudioChannelLayoutTag`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreAudioTypes/AudioChannelLayoutTag)).

segments.source: When you set your associated [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) to any other value, the [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md) only supports one [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md), and you may only set [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) to `kAudioChannelLayoutTag_Unknown` (the default value).
segments.ko: When you set your associated [`multichannelAudioMode`](avcapturedeviceinput/multichannelaudiomode.md) to any other value, the [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md) only supports one [`AVCaptureAudioDataOutput`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput.md), and you may only set [`spatialAudioChannelLayoutTag`](avcaptureaudiodataoutput/spatialaudiochannellayouttag.md) to `kAudioChannelLayoutTag_Unknown` (the default value).

segments.source: Your [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md) validates your app’s adherence to the the above rules when you call `AVCaptureSession/startRunning:` or [`commitConfiguration()`](avcapturesession/commitconfiguration().md) and throws a `NSInvalidArgumentException` if necessary.
segments.ko: [`AVCaptureSession`](avcapturesession.md)는 `AVCaptureSession/startRunning:` 또는 [`commitConfiguration()`](avcapturesession/commitconfiguration().md) 호출 시 앱이 위 규칙을 준수했는지 검사하고 필요하면 `NSInvalidArgumentException`을 throw합니다.

segments.source: The settings used to decode or re-encode audio before it’s output.
segments.ko: 출력 전에 오디오를 디코드하거나 재인코드하는 데 사용되는 설정입니다.
